text: IONQ is down 33% and 56% off its high with negative earnings, insiders selling, and heavy short interest at 12.7% — this quantum computing speculation has failed and it's time to cut the loss.

GEV trades at a stretched 40x earnings with only 9% revenue growth and is already down 10% — in a market where the Fed might hike, that premium valuation is hard to justify, so consider reducing your position size.

Adobe looks genuinely cheap at a PE of just 8.6 with solid 10.5% revenue growth and a rich 10.4% free cash flow yield — this is a proven cash machine trading at a bargain price worth adding to gradually.
Google is down nearly 19% from its high but still growing revenue at 15% with a reasonable 22 PE and insiders buying — that's a quality franchise at a discount worth adding to on this pullback.
UnitedHealth is above its 50-day average, near its high, with insiders buying and 11.8% revenue growth — it checks almost every box for a confident add in a defensive, cash-generating name.
